raw_proposal.draft:
Dear [Customer Name],

Thank you for reaching out to Cedar Systems. We understand that your construction services team is facing challenges with disconnected teams and are looking for workflow coordination and account reporting solutions. We are pleased to arrange a discovery meeting to better understand your requirements and how we can support your needs.

Please let us know a convenient time for the meeting, and we will be in touch shortly.

Best regards,
[Your Name]
Cedar Systems Team
